impact.reason: Prescribes avoid unrequested compatibility layers as a workflow or scope requirement; it does not itself grant permission for destructive or outward-facing action.

purpose.text: Avoid unrequested compatibility layers during refactoring.

revisions.text: - DO NOT create "legacy" / "compatibility" layers unless specifically asked

exclusions: At most three named transcript candidates per unresolved contribution; no archive-wide scan or other-host hunt.
Commit author, task origin fields, injected context and user-relayed reviewer prose do not establish policy authorship.
No new compliance, applicability or causal effectiveness evaluation.
searches.scope: Read historical audit A1-A5 and the imported fragment history. These preferences predate the available repository origin; the audit supplies no named originating dialogue. Recovered the audit pointers to the July dotfiles plan and hq advice outline: prior restatements and an unwritten topic, not original dialogue. No transcript candidate follows from this bounded route.
unresolved: Historic author and human adoption remain unknown. Commit authorship and presence at import do not establish policy authorship. This standing preference has no invented incident, compliance observation or effectiveness claim.
